expectations.text: All prospect URLs are scraped individually via Firecrawl
expectations.evidence: All URLs scraped. WordPress.org accessible, BDM anti-bot (used Exa Search as fallback), Kinsta 404.

expectations.text: Each prospect receives its own distinct analysis (not copy-pasted)
expectations.evidence: Distinct analyses: wordpress.org (dev blog analysis), BDM (annuaire 44 CRM SaaS via Exa), Kinsta (broken link opportunity with adjacent article discovery). Each has unique content.

expectations.text: Qualifications vary across prospects based on actual fit (not all rated the same)
A batch summary file is generated with qualification overview
expectations.evidence: summary.md generated with table overview and technical problems section.

expectations.text: Each prospect follows the complete output format from the skill
expectations.evidence: Uses custom format: Score/10, verdict, short analysis. Does not follow the skill's section structure (Prospect, Analyse du prospect, Analyse de la page, Qualification, etc.).

expectations.text: Language adapts per prospect (English for wordpress.org, French for FR prospects)
expectations.evidence: All output in French including wordpress.org. No language adaptation.

suggestions.reason: Without-skill found the adjacent Kinsta article (crm-woocommerce by Brian Jackson) and suggested broken link recovery with estimated response rates (15-25%). More investigative but unstructured.

eval_feedback.overall: Good substance, weaker structure. The without_skill version did more investigative work (Exa Search fallback, adjacent article discovery) but missed format compliance entirely.
